biography:
With over nine years of experience in the data center industry, I am a seasoned sales leader who is passionate about delivering innovative solutions that enable customer growth and business transformation. As the Senior Director of Commercial Sales at Digital Realty, I oversee a high-performing team of sales professionals who are responsible for generating new revenue, expanding existing accounts, and building long-term relationships with clients across various sectors and markets.

My core competencies include sales strategy, forecasting, campaign management, relationship building, and negotiation. I have a proven track record of exceeding sales targets, driving operational excellence, and creating value for both internal and external stakeholders. I am also adept at leveraging my industry knowledge, market insights, and technical expertise to provide consultative guidance and tailored solutions that meet the evolving needs and challenges of our customers. My mission is to help our customers achieve their goals by providing them with the best data center services, carrier-dense interconnection, and real estate acumen in the industry.
